source: Sentinel-2 L2A via AWS earth-search STAC / public sentinel-cogs bucket (keyless)
method: Per year, up to 6 scenes spread across months with cloud < 25%, median-reduced to one value per year. Reported NDVI is the mean across years; ndvi_std is the ACROSS-YEAR std, which is what VSI means by persistence. Within-year spread is just the monsoon.
albedo: source document §3B coefficients, a Liang (2001)-type narrowband-to-broadband conversion: 0.356 blue, 0.13 red, 0.373 nir, 0.085 swir16, 0.055 swir22
baseline_offset: BOA_ADD_OFFSET = -1000 applied for processing baseline 04.00 (2022-01-25 onward); ignoring it would inflate reflectance by 0.1
